_readme: Cap's address book shown behind the gear button. Edit freely: groups in order, each item needs name, address, desc. network defaults to Base.

items.name: GEAR
items.desc: GEAR ERC-20 token (6 decimals). Main currency for Gear Hub, vault payouts and QR claims.

items.name: CAPH
items.desc: $CAPH ERC-20 token (18 decimals). Used by the CAPH vault, arena games and QR claims.

items.name: Gear Hub Gears
items.desc: GearHubGears ERC-721. The Gear NFTs minted in Gear Hub.

items.name: CAPs Mind Key
items.desc: CAPs Mind key NFT. Unlocks CAPs Mind and gives teammate access in QR Claim admin.

items.name: CAPs Mind Prophecy Tablets
items.desc: CapsMindProphecies. Prophecy tablets for CAPs Mind key holders, paid in GEAR (90% treasury, 10% GearVault).

items.name: GearVault (Gear Hub vault)
items.desc: Holds GEAR and pays it out through approved operators (50 per payout, 10k per day). Owned by the Ledger.

items.name: CAPH Vault
items.desc: Holds CAPH and pays out to approved games with caps. Owned by the Ledger.

items.name: CAPdropper Vault
items.desc: Airdrop and escrow vault behind CAPdropper.

items.name: QR Claim Contract
items.desc: Holds tokens for payup QR codes and pays claims the server signs. Owned by the Ledger.

items.name: Midas Gate Registry
items.desc: Mida_CAP_urGated. Registry for the Midas Gate.

items.name: Ledger (owner)
items.desc: Cap's Ledger cold wallet. Owns GearVault, CAPH Vault, QR Claim and HighScoreRecords. Signs approvals and admin only.

items.name: catgod.base.eth
items.desc: Cap's main wallet. Basenames catgod.base.eth and capstiller.base.eth.

items.name: GEAR Treasury
items.desc: Treasury wallet. Gets 90% of Gear NFT mint fees, CAPH vault fees and prophecy tablet sales.

items.name: GearVault Operator
items.desc: Hot wallet for Caps Garage and game backends that calls GearVault payouts.

items.name: CAPs Mind Key Owner
items.desc: Owner of the CAPs Mind key contract.

items.name: Prophecy Tablets Owner
items.desc: Owner of the Prophecy Tablets contract.

items.name: QR Claim Signer
items.desc: Server signer for QR claims. Signs only. Do not send funds here.
